title: Interacting fronts in the strongly nonlocal Allen--Cahn equation
summary: We study the sharp-interface limit of the fractional Allen--Cahn equation in $\R^n$, $n\geq 2$, in the strongly nonlocal regime $s\in(0,\frac12)$, for initial data consisting of finitely many nested transition layers. We identify a coupled geometric law for the motion of the resulting fronts: each velocity contains fractional mean curvature and a nonlocal interaction potential generated by the other fronts.
